features.subtitle: Every detail is carefully crafted for a better online English learning experience, suitable for programmers, students, office workers, and all keyboard users to quickly improve English typing speed and vocabulary retention

phonetic.title: Phonetic Display & Pronunciation
phonetic.description: Help users memorize pronunciation and phonetics while learning words. Supports standard American pronunciation to help build correct phonetic memory and improve listening and speaking skills.

dictation.title: Smart Dictation Mode
dictation.description: After completing a chapter, users can choose to dictate the chapter to reinforce the words they've learned. Strengthen memory through dictation practice.

stats.title: Precise Data Statistics
stats.description: Quantify typing speed and accuracy so users can track their skill improvement. Supports WPM statistics, accuracy analysis, and progress tracking.

muscleMemory.title: English Muscle Memory Training
muscleMemory.description: Designed specifically for keyboard workers, combining English vocabulary memorization with keyboard muscle memory training to reinforce typing skills while learning words.

errorCorrection.title: Smart Error Correction
errorCorrection.description: To avoid forming incorrect muscle memory, users must retype a word if they make a mistake, ensuring correct muscle memory and spelling habits are maintained.

multiPlatform.title: Seamless Multi-platform Experience
multiPlatform.description: Supports web version and VSCode extension, so you can practice anytime, anywhere. Also provides convenient quick deployment solutions to meet different user needs.
